selection_rule: Ten pre-registered, long-listed Shanghai/Shenzhen main-board securities with complete coverage; replacements were decided only from coverage before strategy performance was read.
known_biases: Fixed research universe, not historical index membership.
Delisted securities are absent; survivorship bias is not eliminated.
Public providers have no production SLA.
Volume is not adjusted for share-count corporate actions.
Historical daily price-limit and independent suspension flags are unavailable.
